behavior: The original defenders gather at one fixed mouth of the first threatened mining base before normal fighting resumes. Arrival uses actual positions; only accepted orders establish or redirect task ownership. Local recovery at that same mine keeps the assignment.

mac1.renderer: native client world renderer; normal planner phases and three-tick command delay
mac1.sampling: every tick for arrival; key frames every 20 game seconds plus the exact all-arrived frame

validation.supplemental_case: Real mountedField ownership is false in the subsequent commander when a higher-priority claim rejected its orders.

limits: Gather time includes three distant catapults and local healing. Firing only at already in-range targets during withdrawal preserves the group. The long pursuit leash and fixed anti-harassment squad are separate following changes. general.ts is unchanged.
